editor_notes_for_email: Ships at 8.633 against a threshold of 7.7 with zero hard fails. Artwork craft 7.3 is under the 8.5 craft floor; the one owed craft cycle was spent (7.0 to 7.3) and the run is at the five-round cap, so no further art repair was possible. Visible residuals: slide 03's coordinates fixture can't be read over the North Pole parcel at thumb size, and slide 07's DRAFT LINE label is 4.3:1 at its worst point. Slide 05's 'The pause makes news' comes before the pause is introduced on 06. Slide 07's GVEA facts repeat No.87 (October 15th). 97 percent is 96.94 rounded, from mapped acreage only. No October 22nd minutes were posted, so the copy says 'the agenda sends'. The October 27th work session is on the Comprehensive Plan, not the ordinance. 'Neither one qualifies' is the deck's reading of the ordinance's own GU-1/GU-5 finding; Title 18's use tables were never read (403).
